sections.heading: C — Passing and following distance
sections.markdown:
## C — Passing and following distance

FACT_ID: sec09-F01 | anchor: A76
A left-turning driver must yield to oncoming intersection traffic unless a traffic-control device directs otherwise. [A76]
Source: [A76 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0076]

FACT_ID: sec09-F02 | anchor: A76
In a work zone, yield to vehicles and pedestrians working on the highway construction project. [A76]
Source: [A76 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0076]

FACT_ID: sec09-F03 | anchor: A76
If a traffic light fails during a power outage, apply the yielding rules of a four-way stop. [A76]
Source: [A76 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0076]

FACT_ID: sec09-F04 | anchor: A76
Pass only when the maneuver will not interfere with oncoming traffic or the vehicle being overtaken. [A76]
Source: [A76 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0076]

FACT_ID: sec09-F05 | anchor: A76
Wait to pass until certain there is enough time to complete it safely. [A76]
Source: [A76 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0076]

FACT_ID: sec09-F06 | anchor: A76
Before returning to the original lane after a pass, signal and wait until the overtaken vehicle is visible in the rear-view mirror. [A76]
Source: [A76 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0076]

FACT_ID: sec09-F07 | anchor: A76
If a pass cannot be completed safely after it begins, fall back and wait for another opening. [A76]
Source: [A76 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0076]

FACT_ID: sec09-F08 | anchor: A76
Passing signs and pavement markings identify prohibited or unsafe locations, but the driver must still determine whether a pass is safe. [A76]
Source: [A76 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0076]

FACT_ID: sec09-F09 | anchor: A76
Do not pass on a two-lane road at or near a hill, curve or obstruction that blocks the view of potentially hazardous oncoming vehicles. [A76]
Source: [A76 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0076]

FACT_ID: sec09-F10 | anchor: A76
Passing within one hundred feet of an intersection is prohibited unless traffic-control devices indicate otherwise. [A76]
Source: [A76 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0076]

FACT_ID: sec09-F11 | anchor: A76
Passing within one hundred feet of a railroad crossing is prohibited unless traffic-control devices indicate otherwise. [A76]
Source: [A76 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0076]

FACT_ID: sec09-F12 | anchor: A77
Do not pass within one hundred feet of a bridge or tunnel when the view is obstructed. [A77]
Source: [A77 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0077]

FACT_ID: sec09-F13 | anchor: A77
Do not overtake a school bus stopped to load or unload passengers. [A77]
Source: [A77 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0077]

FACT_ID: sec09-F14 | anchor: A77
Do not pass a vehicle that has stopped ahead at a marked or unmarked crosswalk to let a pedestrian cross. [A77]
Source: [A77 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0077]

FACT_ID: sec09-F15 | anchor: A77
A pass that requires leaving the pavement or roadway is prohibited. [A77]
Source: [A77 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0077]

FACT_ID: sec09-F16 | anchor: A77
A passenger vehicle or pickup that is not towing may pass a vehicle traveling below the posted limit on a two-lane road posted at least fifty-five miles an hour by exceeding that limit by at most fifteen miles an hour outside a work zone, then returning to the right lane and the posted limit as soon as practicable. [A77]
Source: [A77 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0077]

FACT_ID: sec09-F17 | anchor: A77
On a two-lane two-way road, passing on the right is allowed only when the vehicle ahead signals a left turn and the move is safe without leaving the roadway. [A77]
Source: [A77 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0077]

FACT_ID: sec09-F18 | anchor: A77
On a one-way or multilane street with at least two lanes in the driver's direction, passing on the right is allowed only if safe and without leaving the roadway. [A77]
Source: [A77 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0077]

FACT_ID: sec09-F19 | anchor: A77
Before moving left to pass, check mirrors and blind spots for another vehicle that may already be trying to pass. [A77]
Source: [A77 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0077]

FACT_ID: sec09-F20 | anchor: A77
Signal left before moving into the left lane to pass. [A77]
Source: [A77 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0077]

FACT_ID: sec09-F21 | anchor: A77
After overtaking, wait until the passed vehicle appears in the rear-view mirror, then signal right before returning to the right lane. [A77]
Source: [A77 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0077]

FACT_ID: sec09-F22 | anchor: A78
Use the horn if the vehicle being passed starts drifting toward the passing vehicle. [A78]
Source: [A78 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec09-F23 | anchor: A78
Finish a pass before reaching a point within two hundred feet of oncoming traffic. [A78]
Source: [A78 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec09-F24 | anchor: A78
Complete a pass before entering a No Passing zone identified by signs or pavement markings. [A78]
Source: [A78 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec09-F25 | anchor: A78
When another vehicle passes, move toward the right side of the current lane to provide more room and a better view ahead. [A78]
Source: [A78 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec09-F26 | anchor: A78
Do not accelerate while being passed; keep a steady speed or reduce it. [A78]
Source: [A78 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec09-F27 | anchor: A78
While being passed, watch for the other driver's misjudgment because a quick response can reduce crash risk. [A78]
Source: [A78 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0078]

Misconceptions: The special passing-speed allowance does not apply to every road or every vehicle, and a following-gap recommendation must be increased for adverse conditions.
Mnemonic: Clear, signal and return is a teaching reminder for a supported passing sequence.
Glossary: A no-passing zone bars overtaking; a space cushion leaves room around the vehicle; tailgating means following too closely.
Dynamic facts: actual passing openings, posted controls and weather-dependent spacing are not fixed invented conditions.
